observation.visible_scene: A woman stands centered against a plain beige wall, facing the camera and speaking. She wears a white short-sleeved shirt printed with small multicolored hearts, an orange bib apron bearing the white Chinese characters '妙招姐', a thin necklace, and a lapel microphone clipped to her apron strap. A vertical yellow logo text '妙招姐' sits at the left edge of the frame, and a line of white Chinese subtitles runs along the bottom. Her hands are clasped low in front of her body for most of the clip.
visible_changes: The bottom subtitle changes from '就把这个视频分享给你的家人和朋友吧' (frame 1) to '这样可以帮助更多的人' (frames 2-21), then to '还有记得在下方点赞留言哦' (frames 22-41).
Throughout the clip her mouth opens and closes and her head tilts slightly, consistent with continuous speech.

Around frame 27 (t=2.08) her right arm (viewer's left) lifts out of the clasped position; from frame 28 (t=2.16) to the end (frame 41) her right hand is held raised in a downward-pointing gesture (fist with digit/thumb directed toward the bottom of the screen), with only small positional shifts.
The left-side logo text, apron text, clothing, and background remain unchanged across all frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: The spoken content before frame 1 and after frame 41 is not shown.
Whether the viewer actually performs the share/like/comment actions referenced by the subtitles is outside the clip.
The start and end of the pointing gesture are not captured; the gesture is already forming within the excerpt and continues to the last frame.
uncertain_details: The exact hand configuration of the downward gesture (index finger vs. thumb pointing down) is hard to resolve.
Camera motion is indeterminate; the static background suggests no deliberate pan/zoom, but minor framing cannot be confirmed.
The precise timing of subtitle swaps between sampled frames is approximate.
